ev.q: Three new outbreaks of circulating VDPVs (cVDPVs), ranging in size from six to 16 cases, were identified in Afghanistan, Ethiopia, and India
from two in the previous reporting period ( 3 ) to nine currently, seven of which were associated with iVDPV2
The outbreak peaked at 153 cases in 2009, but 27 cases were detected in 2010
Of 13 samples collected, 11 contained heterotypic VDPV mixtures
a total of 355 AFP cases associated with an outbreak of cVDPV2
the number of identified cVDPV outbreaks per year has increased over time
from two in the previous reporting period ( 3 ) to nine currently
This report updates previous surveillance summaries

methods_quotes.q: VRPVs that differ from the corresponding OPV strain by >1% of nucleotide positions
Duration of cVDPV circulation was estimated from extent of VP1 nucleotide divergence from the corresponding Sabin OPV strain
duration of iVDPV replication was estimated from clinical record by assuming that exposure was from initial receipt of OPV
Count does not include 29 cases with <10 nucleotide substitutions in VP1 detected before 2010
